description: PWM on pin 11: 0, then 25 (the same example on the Nano).
basis: the output of the example on the Uno (class derived: derived by hand from the sketch source (C++ semantics, avr-gcc: int is 16 bit) and the 'Beobachtung' comment of the example; wiring_analog.c: analogWrite(0) is digitalWrite(LOW), 25 sets OCR2A = 25) holds for the Nano: it has the ATmega328P of the Uno at 16 MHz, the pins 0 to 19 are numbered alike (A0 = 14, pins_arduino.h of the eightanaloginputs variant) and the sketch uses neither A6 nor A7; no recording on a Nano exists
